newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish December core inflation rises 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish December core inflation rises 0.4 pct.

text.p: Finnish core inflation rose 0.4 percent year-on-year in December after rising 0.4 percent in November, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Friday.
The mean of six economists' forecasts for the increase in December core inflation was 0.5 percent in a 0.4-0.6 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- one of the central bank's gauges for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
